s: Din mi shehechshik lo badderek ubo k"z seipim: mi shehaya ba badderek veqiddesh alayv hayyom vehayu immo maot, veyesh lo chamoro vegam yesh immo nokri — lo yanniach kiso al chamoro, mippene shehu metzuvveh al shebitato, ella yittenennu lenokri leholiko lo beshabbat ad meqom shebitato, shehu tok hattechum mimmaqom sheqqiddesh alayv hayyom, ulemotzae shabbat loqecho mimmennu. Veap al pi shello natan lo sakar al zeh shennimtza toreach bishbil yisrael, veap al pi shennatan lo mishshechasheka — hare zeh muttar, mippene sheen adam maamid atzmo al mamono, veim lo nattir lo tiltul hammaot veholaka al yede nokri sheen issuran ella middibre soperim — yabo leholiko beatzmo veyaabor al issur shel tora. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yesh lo litteno lo mibbeod yom, velo letaltel muqtzeh beshshabbat:

Bameh debarim amurim? Bekiso, abal im matza metzia — lo hittiru lo littenah lenokri apillu mibbeod yom, lepi sheen adam bahul kol kak al hammetzia kemo al shello mammash veyukal lehaamid atzmo shello labo lide issur shel tora bishbilah. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheadayin lo higbiah otah, abal im kebar higbihah uba leyado mibbeod yom — naaset keshello mammash:

Im en immo nokri o sheeno maamino lenokri — manniach kiso al chamoro. Ukede shelo yaabor al shebitat behemto — yannichennu aleha leachar sheoqra yad varegel laleket, sheakshav en kan issur min hattora, sheen issur min hattora bemaabir d' ammot birshut harabbim, o bemotzi mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, o bemaknis mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid, ela kesheadam echad oqer et hachepetz mimmeqom hannachato umaabiro, o motzio, o makniso. Veken im acher aqar hachepetz vehinnicho al zeh keshehu omed, shemmiyyad shehinnicho alayv keshehu omed kebar naaset hannacha lechepetz zeh laaqira zo harishona, veachar kak keshezzeh oqer raglayv laleket — hare zo aqira sheniyya lechepetz zeh vechayyab. Abal im acher hinnicho alayv leachar shehu aqar kebar raglayv laleket — lo naaset adayin hannacha laaqira harishona sheaqar chabero, ulepikak ap shezzeh holik hachepetz achar kak harbeh — patur hu, mippene shello asa kol hammelaka, shechosra lo haaqira sheasaah chabero, ella sheasur middibre soperim. Vekan keshemmanniach al behemto achar sheoqra yad varegel — muttar apillu lekattechilla, shehittiru lo mishshum hepsed kiso, shello yabo leholiko beatzmo. Ukeshehabbehema omedet lehashtin mayim, o lehattil gelalim vekayyotze bazeh, vekol shekken im omedet lanuach — tzarik littol hakkis mimmenna, uleachar shettachazor vetaaqor yad varegel laleket — yannichennu aleha, sheim lo yaaseh ken yesh kan issur shel tora, shehare kesheomda naaset hannacha laaqira harishona sheaqar hu, ukeshechozeret lelek — hare hi beatzmah osa aqira lakkis, ukeshettanuach achar kak taaseh gam hannacha, vahare kan melaka gemura. Ulekattechilla tzarik littelo mimmenna keshettirtzeh laamod qodem sheomda, kede shello taaseh apillu hannacha laaqira harishona sheaqar hu, sheap sheen kan ella issur middibre soperim ap im taaseh hannacha zo, mikkol maqom kol mah sheepshar lemaet beissure dibre soperim — tzarik lemaet, shehare lo hittiru ella mippene haddochaq. Veken yaaseh leolam bekol paam shettirtzeh laamod — yittelennu mealeha, ukeshettaaqor laleket — yannichennu aleha (ad sheyyaggia lechatzer hachitzona shel hair, kemo sheyyitbaer):

Vaapillu im en habbehema shello, sheen kan issur mishshum shebitat behemto — ap al pi ken tzarik lizzaher bekol zeh, dekevan shehu mechammer achareha, im taaseh melaka gemura — yaabor al lo taaseh ap al pi sheenah shello. Umikkol maqom, im enah shello — tzarik lehannicho aleha apillu yesh immo nokri, dekevan shehu nizhar shello taaseh melaka gemura haasura min hattora ella dabar sheen bo issur ella middibre soperim ap im adam haya oseh kayyotze bo, im ken mutab sheyyaaseh al yede habbehema dabar haasur lo beatzmo middibre soperim mishsheyyaaseh beatzmo dabar haasur middibre soperim, dehaynu haamira lenokri unetinat hakkis elayv sheyyolikennu lo veyaaseh shelichuto beshabbat. Abal keshehabbehema shello vehu metzuvveh al shebitatah, ap shennizhar shello taaseh melaka gemura, mikkol maqom yoter tob shettishbot legamre, lepikak tzarik litten kiso lenokri sheeno metzuvveh al shebitato:
Veim hu massa kabed shello yukal hannokri laset oto beyadayv — yitten gam hachamor lenokri bemattana gemura, o yapqirenna, vaazay dinah kibhema sheeno shello kelal, ukemo shennitbaer:

Ap al pi shehittiru lo lehanniach kiso al chamoro — lo hittiru lo lirkob alayv. (Vaapillu im hu beinyan sheim lo yirkab alayv vehakkis tachtayv ella yehe hakkis megulleh al chamoro, yihyeh sham chashash millistim shello yigzelehu mimmennu, ap al pi ken lo hittiru lo issur rekiba bidrakim shellanu (sheen lahem din reshut harabbim gemura, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shm"h), veap im lo nattir lo harekiba — lo yabo lide issur shel tora ap im yolikenna beatzmo, umah hepresh lanu ben issur harekiba uben issur hakkarmelit, shenehem hem middibre soperim. Lepikak en lehattir lo (ella tiltul hammaot veholaka al yede habbehema belo aqira vehannacha, kede shello yabo leholik beatzmo vitaltel gam ken hammaot veyaaseh gam ken aqira vehannacha, umutab lehattir lo meat middibre soperim mishsheyyaabor al harbeh middibre soperim bezadon, abal) harekiba (en lehattir lo), ella yelek beraglayv:

Vaapillu im hu tzarik latzet chutz lattechum mippene chashash sakkana, ukesheyyirkab al hachamor yihyu raglayv teluyot lemala mi' tepachim min haaretz, vekol lemala mi' tepachim en bo mishshum issur techumin, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"ch, ukesheyyelek beraglayv yaabor al issur techumin, vaapillu issur techumin shehem min hattora, kegon chutz ley"b mil lehaomerim shehem min hattora, ap al pi ken yelek beraglayv, lepi sheap shekkesheyyirkob yihyu raglayv lemala mi' tepachim, mikkol maqom kevan shehu yosheb bemaqom shennoach tashmisho, dehaynu al gabbe hachamor shehu maqom noach letashmish yeshiba veragle hachamor nogeim baaretz — hare zeh domeh leholek beqaron, sheap al pi sheggaboah y' tepachim, mikkol maqom im yesh bo d' al d' — yesh bo mishshum techumin, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"d. Umikkol maqom, im hu beinyan sheyyesh chashash sakkana im lo yirkab veyelek beqaron, kegon sheholek bammidbar im shayyara velo yukal laleket immahem im yelek beraglayv, vekol kayyotze bazeh — yakol lirkob velelek beqaron ap kesheodennu betok hattechum sheen sham issur kelal bahalika baregel:

Ukesheen sham chashash sakkana vetzarik lered min haqqaron im lo yarad mimmennu mibbeod yom — tzarik lehasir mimmennu kol chapatzayv ulehannicham al haqqaron qodem sheyyered mimmennu im gup haagala atzmah belo haggalgallim hi rechaba d' vegam hi geboha y' tepachim belo haggalgallim, sheaz hi reshut hayyachid gemura ap al pi sheyyesh chalal harbeh tachteha, im ken kesheyyered al haaretz shehi karmelit asur lo letaltel mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid. Veim en haagala geboha y' tepachim beatzmah, ap al pi sheggeboha y' tepachim im haggalgallim — enah reshut hayyachid im yesh tachteha chalal g' tepachim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shm"h, umuttar letaltel mikkarmelit letokah. Veim en rechaba d' tepachim, ap al pi sheggeboha beatzmah y' tepachim — hare zeh maqom petur, umuttar letaltel apillu mereshut harabbim letoko. Veim hi milmala rechaba d' tepachim, ap al pi shemmillematta enah rechaba d' tepachim — hare zo reshut hayyachid, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:

Im en immo lo chamor velo nokri, im yesh immo cheresh veshoteh veqatan — yitten kiso lehashshoteh sheyyolikennu lo, shehu patur mikkol hammitzvot. Velo yittenennu lecheresh veqatan ap al pi sheggam hem peturim, mikkol maqom hacheresh yesh lo daat muetet umitchallep bepiqqeach, vehaqqatan yabo liklal daat ulehitchayyeb bemitzvot, abal hashshoteh en lo daat kelal, velo yabo liklal daat. Abal im en immo shoteh ella cheresh o qatan — yittenennu lahem. Veim yesh immo cheresh veqatan — yittenennu leezeh sheyyirtzeh, lepi sheshshenehem shequlim, shehacheresh yesh lo daat muetet, vehaqqatan ap al pi sheen lo daat kelal, mikkol maqom yabo liklal daat gemura kesheyyigdal:

Veyakol litteno leqatan apillu higgia lechinnuk vehu beno shechayyab lechanneko bemitzvot, mikkol maqom chinnuk zeh eno ella middibre soperim, vehittiru lo chakamim kede shello yabo laasot beatzmo. Umikkol maqom, keshennoteno lo o apillu lecheresh veshoteh — tzarik litteno lahem kesheaqeru raglehem laleket, velittelo mehem keshehem rotzim laamod, kede shello yaasu aqira vehannacha, kemo shennitbaer lemala, sheap sheeno metzuvveh al shebitatam, mikkol maqom hare asur lehaakilam dabar haasur beyadayim min hattora, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shm"g, vezeh shennoten lahem kiso, ap al pi shennoten lahem mibbeod yom, mikkol maqom kevan sheyyodea sheyyolikuhu beshabbat uledaat ken noten lahem — hare zeh kemaakilam issur beyadayim, lepikak en hetter ella shello yaasu aqira vehannacha, sheaz en bezeh issur shel tora (ap im haya birshut harabbim gemura), vehittiru lo chakamim issur shel dibrehem kede shello yabo laasot beatzmo. Umikkol maqom, im haya immo chamor — yannichennu al chamoro, velo yittenennu leechad meellu, shehem biklal adam, veyesh beminam shechayyabim bemitzvot, veyitchallepu bahem:

Veim en immo shum echad mikkol ellu — hittiru lo letaltel beshabbat kiso, o metzia shebbaa leyado mibbeod yom, pachot pachot mid' ammot, dehaynu shello yolikem d' ammot retzupim mishsheqqiddesh hayyom, ella yelek immahem pachot mid' ammot, veyaamod meat lanuach, veyachazor veyelek pachot mid' ammot, veyaamod meat lanuach, veken yaaseh ad sheyyaggia limqom shebitato. Veim amad letaqqen massao — en amida zo mapseqet, ella tzarik sheyyaamod kede lanuach. Veyesh machmirin bekol maqom shehittiru tiltul pachot pachot mid' ammot, sheyyesheb bekol pachot mid' amot, abal haamida enah kelum, kevan sheen kavvanato baamidato bishbil lanuach ulehinnapesh, ella hu rotzeh lanuach kede lehattir issur tiltul d' amot. Vetob lachush lidbarayv bemaqom sheepshar:

Umikkol maqom, en pachot pachot mid' amot moil ella leinyan issur maabir d' ammot birshut harabbim, abal lo leinyan hotzaa mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, velo leinyan haknasa mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid. Ella ketzad yaaseh? Keshemmaggia lebeto im kiso, im yaknisennu kedarko — nimtza maknis mereshut harabbim o karmelit lirshut hayyachid, ella miyyad sheyyaggia lepetach beto qodem sheyyaamod sham — yizreqennu lebeto kilachar yad, dehaynu shello kederek zeriqa, kegon mikketepayv uleacharayv. Veen bizriqa zo issur min hattora, veap im hi reshut harabbim gemura, ella middibre soperim, vehittiru lo kede shello yabo lehakniso kedarko:

Veim eno yakol leholikah pachot pachot mid' ammot mippene shemmityare millistim shello yigzeluhu mimmennu, veken apillu im yesh immo chamor umityare lehannicho alayv mippene hallistim, sheim yannichennu alayv veyittelennu bekol et sheyyaamod kemo shennitbaer, yiruhu hallistim veyigzeluhu mimmennu — yakol larutz im kiso ad sheyyaggia lebeto, sheen kan issur shel tora ap im hi reshut harabbim gemura im hitchil larutz qodem sheqqiddesh alayv hayyom, shello hayeta haaqira beshabbat, vekol zeman shehu ratz en kan aqira vehannacha, ad sheyyaggia samuk labbayit, veaz qodem sheyyaamod lipne petach beto veteaseh hannacha — tzarik hu lizroq kiso letok beto kilachar yad, kede shello yaknis mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid. Ubizman hazzeh sheen lanu reshut harabbim ella karmelit — yesh lehattir ap im matchil larutz mishshechasheka, raq qodem sheyyaamod lipne petach beto yizreqennu kilachar yad, shennimtza sheen kan ella aqira belo hannacha:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehu ratz, abal lelek leat lo hittiru lo apillu im hitchil mibbeod yom, lepi shellipamim yaamod meat belo daat veyachazor veyelek, venimtza oseh aqira vehannacha beshabbat, mah sheen ken keshehu ratz yesh lo hekker vezikkaron beritza zo sheasur lo laamod, velo yabo lishkoach:

Veken mi shehayeta chabilato al ketepo veqiddesh alayv hayyom — ratz tachteha apillu birshut harabbim ad shemmaggia lipne petach beto, veyizreqenna sham kilachar yad. Veap im amad beemtza merutzato letaqqen hammassoy — patur (ella shellekattechilla asur laamod kelal, ella im ken i epshar lo beinyan acher):

Vekol zeh bemi shehechshik lo badderek, sheeno poshea, shehaya sabur sheadayin yesh shahut bayyom labo lair. Abal mi sheyyatza mibbeto samuk lachasheka vehotzi kiso immo lirshut harabbim, o apillu lekarmelit, veshakach achar kak lahasiro mimmennu ulehatznio qodem shechasheka — lo hittiru lo shum echad mehadderakim haellu, apillu lomar lenokri lehatznio, hoil upasha bo sheyyatza im kiso samuk lachasheka, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"b:

Abal im haya kiso taluy bachagoro ushekacho, velo yada bo bishat yetziato lirshut harabbim samuk lachasheka, vaapillu shakach kiso alayv ad shechasheka veachar kak (hotzio) yatza immo lirshut harabbim, o apillu yada shekkiso alayv bishat yetziato, ella sheyyatza mibbeod yom velo samuk lachasheka, sheeno poshea bazeh, veachar kak shekacho lehatznio ad shechasheka — muttar lo litteno lenokri sheyyebiennu lo lebeto. Veim en immo nokri, o sheeno maamino — yolikennu pachot pachot mid' ammot, veyizreqennu lebeto kilachar yad. Veim mityare shello yigzeluhu mimmennu — rashshay larutz ad lipne beto kemo shennitbaer, shehittiru kol zeh kede shello yabo leholiko kedarko baaqira vehannacha, sheen adam maamid atzmo al mamono, ubevadday lo yaazbenu bashshuq keshei epshar leshomro sham (al yede shomer nokri o shomer yisrael) ad lemotzae shabbat:

Abal im epshar leshomro sham ad lemotzae shabbat — asur lahabio lebeto apillu al yede nokri, ella mattir chagora bashshuq vehakkis nopel, veomer lenokri leshomro. Veim mebio hannokri meatzmo — en tzarik lomar lo kelum:

Umi sheshshakach kiso alayv venizkar beshabbat keshehu betok habbayit o betok hechatzer, o apillu betok ir hamorebet — yakol lelek immo ad letok cheder mutzna, vesham yattir chagoro vehakkis nopel, veen bazeh issur tiltul muqtzeh, dekevan shehammuqtzeh yeshno alayv kebar — hare hu yakol lenoso alayv lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"ch (veod shezzehu tiltul al yede gupo velo beyadayv, veen bo issur kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a):

Vekol zeh bekiso, o metzia shebbaa leyado mibbeod yom, abal im matza arnaqi beshabbat (apillu betok ir hamorebet) — asur apillu lomar lenokri littelo ap al pi sheyyare pen yeqaddemennu acher, dekevan sheadam yakol lehaamid atzmo aleha — lo hittiru lo shum issur shel dibrehem (apillu issur tiltul muqtzeh al yede nokri, sheap sheyyesh mattirin issur zeh bimqom hepsed merubbeh, mikkol maqom kan eno mapsid kelum mishshello ella shennimna meharevach). Umikkol maqom, muttar lesheb etzlo uleshomro ad lemotzae shabbat, shemmuttar lishmor hammuqtzeh beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"[v]. Vekol shekken shemmuttar lomar lenokri leshomro (veim mebio meatzmo — en tzarik lomar lo kelum):

Mi shebba min hadderek belel shabbat ubehemto teuna (shennatal hammassoy mealeha kesherotzta laamod vehinnicho aleha keshehi mehalleket, o shehechshik keshehi haleka samuk lair), kesheyyaggia lechatzer hachitzona shel hair shehu maqom hammishtammer harishon — notel mealeha hakkelim hammuttarim letaltelam beshabbat. (Ulekattechilla yittelem qodem sheomda bechatzer, kede shello taaseh hi hannacha. Veim omda — en bekak kelum, shehi hannacha belo aqira, shehare keshehiggia lipne petach hechatzer sheomda sham meat qodem shenniknesa, tzarik haya littol hammassoy mealeha qodem sheomda ulehannicho aleha achar sheoqra ragleha likkanes lechatzer kede shello taaseh hi hannacha vaaqira, kemo shennitbaer lemala). Vaapillu im hammassoy hu yoter mit"v sein, sheim haya al agala haya asur lehorido mimmenna beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"g, mikkol maqom meal habbehema lo gazeru al zeh, mippene tzaar baale chayyim:
Veim yesh aleha debarim hammuqtzim — mattir et hachabalim shel haukkap shehassaqqim qeshurim bahem vehassaqqim nopelim mealehem:

Hayu bassaqqim debarim hammishtabberim im yippelu, kegon kele zekukit haasurim letaltelam, kegon shehem kosot shel maqqize dam sheen reuyim beshabbat liklum, lepi shehem meusim vei epshar lehishtammesh betokam, umuqtzeh mechamat mius kazeh eno muttar betiltul beshabbat, ella im ken rauy lekassot bo kelim vekayyotze bazeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"ch, abal ellu enan reuyim lekak, shemmaqpid alehem lehishtammesh bahem beinyan zeh shello yippelu veyishtabberu, ketzad yaaseh littelam meal hachamor? Mebi karim ukesatot umanniach tachtehem, umattir hachabalim vehassaqqim nopelim al hakkarim ukesatot:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Besaqqim qetannim, sheyyakol lishmot hakkarim mittachtehem (liksheyyirtzeh), sheshshomet kar haelyon mittachtehem venopelim al hashsheni, umin hashsheni al hashshelishi, veken ad shemmaggiim laaretz, shehassaqqim lo naasu basis lidbar haissur, kevan shello hayu hassaqqim alehem beben hashshemashot shehu techillat kenisat hashshabbat. Abal im hem saqqim gedolim shei epshar lishmot hakkarim mittachtehem — asur lehannichan tachtehen, mippene shemmebattel keli mehekano, ella poreqan min hachamor benachat shello yishshaberu. Veap al pi shei epshar lipriqa benachat belo tiltul qetzat, mikkol maqom hittiru lo dabar zeh mippene hepsed merubbeh. Vetzarik lizzaher shello yismok al habbehema keshepporeq mealeha, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"h:

Veim i epshar liproq benachat shello yishshaberu — yesh mattirin lehanniach karim ukesatot tachtehem, shello gazeru al bittul keli mehekano bimqom hepsed merubbeh. Abal eno yakol lehannichan al hachamor ad lemotzae shabbat, mippene tzaar baale chayyim shehu asur min hattora:

Vekol zeh bekelim hammuqtzim sheyyesh hepsed merubbeh bishbiratan, abal im hayu chatikot zekukit rechabot sheosim mehen chalonot, sheen bishbiratan ella hepsed muat, shehare sopan lehechatek lachatikot qetannot — asur lehanniach tachtehen karim ukesatot, apillu hen massaot qetannim sheepshar lishmot hakkarim mittachtehem, mikkol maqom ad sheyyaspiq leshomtam kullam benachat shello yishshaberu hakkelim — hare kebar hem mebuttalim mehekanam beotah shaa, veasur lebattel keli mehekano apillu lepi shaa shello bimqom hepsed. Vekol shekken sheasur leporqan benachat, shei epshar belo tiltul qetzat, ella tzarik lehattir hachabalim sheyyippelu hassaqqim meal habbehema:

Mi shechoshka lo badderek utepillin berosho, o sheyyosheb bebet hammidrash shebbassadeh vechoshka lo — muttar lelek bahem lebeto, ap al pi sheasur latzet bitpillin beshabbat, mikkol maqom mishshum bizyon hattepillin shello yannichan bassadeh o bebet hammidrash shebbassadeh sheeno maqom hammishtammer — hittiru lo lelek labush bahen ad beto sheyyatznien sham. Ukeshehu mehallek bahen — tzarik lehanniach yado alehen lekassotan mippene haroim, shello yachsheduhu. Veim yesh bayit samuk lachoma shehen mishtammerin sham — choletzan umatznian sham, velo yelek bahen ad beto (ukebar nitbaer zeh besimman l'):
